```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

inph <- read.csv(here("00_data", "03_func_data", "output", "inph_functional_data.csv"),row.names=1) 


## create binary list of phages w/ and w/out ParS hits
inph2 <- inph %>% group_by(Accession) %>%
  summarise(total.protein.coding = sum(gene_length), .groups = "drop") #%>% 
#ParS.pos %>% count(phage_spor_host)

df <- read.csv(here("00_data", "01_desc", "CompleteMetadata.csv"), row.names=1)
df <- subset(df, df$dataset=="INPHARED")

df <- merge(df, inph2, by="Accession", all.x=FALSE, all.y=FALSE)
df$coding.density <- df$total.protein.coding/df$contig_length

df.bac <- subset(df, df$Bacillota=="Bacillota")




bac.stat <- read.csv(here("00_data", "01_desc", "metadata", "NCBI", "SummaryStatsBacillotaGenomes.csv"), row.names=1)

bac.stat <- select(bac.stat, gtdb_f, host.genome.length, host.gene.count, host.GC)


df.bac <- merge(df.bac, bac.stat, by="gtdb_f", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
df.bac[is.na(df.bac)] <- 0

df.bac.stats <- subset(df.bac, df.bac$host.GC!=0)


```


```{r}
ggplot(df.bac, aes(x = factor(phage_spor_host), fill = factor(phage_spor_host), y = coding.density)) + 
  geom_boxplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", position = "dodge") + geom_jitter(width = 0.2)  +  ylab("log10 (Genome Size)") + xlab("") + ggtitle("INPHARED") + labs(fill="Lifestyle")



library(ggpubr)
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(spor), fill = factor(spor), y = contig_length)) + 
  geom_boxplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", position = "dodge") + geom_jitter(width = 0.2)  +  ylab("log10 (Genome Size)") + xlab("") + ggtitle("INPHARED") + labs(fill="Lifestyle")




ggplot(df.bac, aes(x = coding.density, fill = phage_spor_host)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), 
                 alpha = 0.5, position = "identity", binwidth = .01) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Independent Densities (Each Species Area = 1) of \nPhage Coding Density / Host Coding Density")+ facet_wrap(~lifestyle , ncol = 1) + xlab ("phage coding density / host coding density")

wilcox.test(
  df.bac$coding.density[df.bac$lifestyle == "Lytic" & df.bac$f_spor == TRUE],
  df.bac$coding.density[df.bac$lifestyle == "Lytic" & df.bac$f_spor == FALSE],
  alternative = "two.sided",
  exact = FALSE
)

wilcox.test(
  df.bac$coding.density[df.bac$lifestyle == "Temperate" & df.bac$f_spor == TRUE],
  df.bac$coding.density[df.bac$lifestyle == "Temperate" & df.bac$f_spor == FALSE],
  alternative = "two.sided",
  exact = FALSE
)
```
```{r}
# ---- packages --------------------------------------------------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)    # for arranging plots; install if needed
# install.packages(c("patchwork","effsize")) if not installed
library(effsize)      # for Cliff's delta (cliff.delta)

# ---- prepare data ---------------------------------------------------------
dat <- df.bac %>%
  filter(lifestyle == "Temperate") %>%
  select(coding.density, f_spor) %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(f_spor, "sporulating", "non-sporulating"),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("sporulating", "non-sporulating")))

# quick sample sizes
table(dat$group)

# ---- A. ECDF plot ---------------------------------------------------------
p_ecdf <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = coding.density, colour = group, linetype = group)) +
  stat_ecdf(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "ECDF of coding.density — Temperate bacteria",
       x = "coding.density", y = "Empirical CDF",
       colour = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

# ---- B. Density plot (smoothed) -------------------------------------------
p_density <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = coding.density, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35) +
  labs(title = "Density estimate of coding.density",
       x = "coding.density", y = "Density",
       fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

# ---- C. Violin + inner boxplot + jitter -----------------------------------
p_violin <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = group, y = coding.density, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.13, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Violin + boxplot of coding.density, Temperate",
       x = "", y = "coding.density") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ---- Combine plots --------------------------------------------------------
combined_plot <- (p_ecdf | p_density) / p_violin + 
  plot_annotation(caption = "Groups: sporulating vs non-sporulating (Temperate)")
print(combined_plot)

# ---- D. Effect-size numbers ------------------------------------------------
# 1) median difference (sporulating - non-sporulating)
med_sp <- median(dat$coding.density[dat$group == "sporulating"], na.rm = TRUE)
med_nsp <- median(dat$coding.density[dat$group == "non-sporulating"], na.rm = TRUE)
delta_median <- med_sp - med_nsp

# 2) mean difference
mean_sp <- mean(dat$coding.density[dat$group == "sporulating"], na.rm = TRUE)
mean_nsp <- mean(dat$coding.density[dat$group == "non-sporulating"], na.rm = TRUE)
delta_mean <- mean_sp - mean_nsp

# 3) Cliff's delta (with effsize::cliff.delta)
cd <- cliff.delta(coding.density ~ group, data = dat, conf.level = 0.95) 
# cd$estimate is Cliff's delta; cd$magnitude gives small/medium/large

# 4) Common-language effect size (probability a random sporulating > random non-sporulating)
x <- dat$coding.density[dat$group == "sporulating"]
y <- dat$coding.density[dat$group == "non-sporulating"]
# compute pairwise comparisons
pairs <- outer(x, y, FUN = function(a,b) ifelse(a > b, 1, ifelse(a < b, 0, 0.5)))
cl_effect <- mean(pairs, na.rm = TRUE)  # probability sporulating > non-sporulating

# 5) Permutation (median) — quick p-value (optional)
set.seed(42)
obs_med_diff <- delta_median
nperm <- 10000
all_x <- dat$coding.density
group_labels <- dat$group
perm_med <- replicate(nperm, {
  lab_perm <- sample(group_labels)
  median(all_x[lab_perm == "sporulating"], na.rm = TRUE) -
    median(all_x[lab_perm == "non-sporulating"], na.rm = TRUE)
})
perm_pval <- mean(abs(perm_med) >= abs(obs_med_diff))

# ---- E. Print effect-size summary -----------------------------------------
cat("\nEffect-size summary (Temperate — sporulating minus non-sporulating):\n")
cat(sprintf("Median(s)   : sporulating = %.4f, non-sporulating = %.4f, Δmedian = %.4f\n",
            med_sp, med_nsp, delta_median))
cat(sprintf("Mean(s)     : sporulating = %.4f, non-sporulating = %.4f, Δmean = %.4f\n",
            mean_sp, mean_nsp, delta_mean))
cat(sprintf("Cliff's δ   : estimate = %.4f, magnitude = %s\n",
            cd$estimate, cd$magnitude))
cat(sprintf("Common-lang : P(sporulating > non-sporulating) = %.3f\n", cl_effect))
cat(sprintf("Perm (median) p-value (n=%d) = %.4f\n\n", nperm, perm_pval))

# ---- F. Optional: Annotate violin with median difference -------------------
# Add text annotation to violin
ann_text <- paste0("Δmedian = ", signif(delta_median, 3),
                   "\nCliff's δ = ", signif(cd$estimate, 3),
                   "\nP_CL = ", signif(cl_effect, 3))
p_violin_annot <- p_violin +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(dat$coding.density, na.rm = TRUE), label = ann_text,
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5)+ ylab("Ratio between phage and host coding density") +ggtitle("Temperate")


print(p_violin_annot)


#ggsave(here("01_desc_stats", "figs", "effect_size", "Temperate_PLRatio_violin.png"))
```
